_comment: ABILITY EVOLUTIONS — Steve 2026-10-11. At L3 mastery, an ability EVOLVES: the player chooses what it becomes. Family-level (pool-level), 2 divergent paths per family. Every evolution moves the needle (see needle{}) AND changes how the ability plays (see verb). Retune-first, never cut.

evolutions.choiceText: Your hands have learned perfect economy. Healing shouldn't cost the healer.
evolutions.flavor: The knowledge in your fingers stops asking permission.
evolutions.name: Combat Surgeon
evolutions.verb: Treating others costs you nothing — your hands have learned perfect economy. (Was 150 kcal.)

evolutions.choiceText: You've seen what sickness does to a village. Your care wants to reach further — to stop it before it starts.
evolutions.flavor: You don't just heal the sick anymore. You make the village uninviting to sickness itself.
evolutions.name: Plague Warden

needle.delta: treated villagers resist new infection 3 days

evolutions.verb: Treating a villager also hardens them: -30% disease chance for 3 days.

evolutions.choiceText: The trail has never lied to you. Now it never lets go — wounded prey cannot shake you.
evolutions.flavor: You don't follow the blood. The blood follows you, begging to be found.
evolutions.name: Bloodline
evolutions.verb: Wounded prey cannot shake you: +15% hunt success as the blood tells you everything.

evolutions.choiceText: You wake knowing where the herds will be. Not guessing — knowing, the way you know your own hands.
evolutions.flavor: The animals dream, and lately, so do you. Same dream.
evolutions.name: Herd Dream
evolutions.verb: You sense herds before you see them — the hunt comes to you.

evolutions.choiceText: The first seconds of a fight have always been yours. Now they belong to you completely — and so do the seconds after.
evolutions.flavor: Something old wakes up when the fighting starts. It is very good at this.
evolutions.name: Red Mist
evolutions.verb: Strike first AND counterattack: +1 free strike when an enemy misses you.

evolutions.choiceText: You've spent fights watching others bleed. Your body wants to be the wall between them and the teeth.
evolutions.flavor: You stop dodging. You start standing in the way. It works.
evolutions.name: Iron Warden
evolutions.verb: Intercept: take a hit meant for an ally once per fight.

evolutions.choiceText: Fire and smoke have stopped being tools. They're collaborators now — they want the food to last as much as you do.
evolutions.flavor: The smoke curls the way you ask it to. You've stopped finding that strange.
evolutions.name: Smoke Prophet
evolutions.verb: Smoking never fails and yields +50%: the smoke obeys.

evolutions.choiceText: Every carcass you've dressed taught you something. Now nothing is wasted — bone, sinew, organ, all of it feeds someone.
evolutions.flavor: The old ones had a word for people like you. It meant 'the one who feeds.'
evolutions.name: Waste Not
evolutions.verb: Butchering yields +60%: you use the whole animal.

evolutions.choiceText: People listen when you speak now. Not politely — really. Your word can lift someone or end them.
evolutions.flavor: You never wanted power. That's exactly why they trust you with it.
evolutions.name: Kingmaker
evolutions.verb: Your endorsement decides leadership challenges: +50% trust gain when backing someone.

evolutions.choiceText: Villagers tell you things they tell no one else. The weight of it is becoming a kind of sight.
evolutions.flavor: Every secret is a thread. You're starting to see the whole cloth.
evolutions.name: Confessor
evolutions.verb: Secrets surface around you: your lie sense (+0.3) turns whispers into warnings.

evolutions.choiceText: Distance has become a suggestion. The land between fires is yours now — walk it like you own it.
evolutions.flavor: You don't get lost. The land gets found.
evolutions.name: Path Lord
evolutions.verb: Travel costs half: you walk the world like a road you built.

evolutions.choiceText: You see further than your feet can take you. The next valley, the next fire — read them before you walk.
evolutions.flavor: The horizon leans in when you look at it.
evolutions.name: Far Seer
evolutions.verb: You read distant land like a map: +30% ruin finds without the wasted trips.

evolutions.choiceText: Lies have textures now. You don't catch them — you see through them to the fear underneath.
evolutions.flavor: Everyone lies. Now you know what the lie is FOR.
evolutions.name: Mind Reader
evolutions.verb: See MOTIVES, not just lies: know why they're lying, every time.

evolutions.choiceText: Places remember. You've learned to ask them what they saw.
evolutions.flavor: The ground keeps receipts. You're learning to read them.
evolutions.name: Cold Case
evolutions.verb: Scenes speak: +25% drama resolution as you reconstruct what happened.

evolutions.choiceText: The knack was never a trick. It was inheritance — something your bloodline carried and forgot. It's remembering now.
evolutions.flavor: Your grandmother had this. Hers was stronger. Yours is catching up.
evolutions.name: Old Blood
evolutions.verb: The knack deepens into ancestry: +20% luck as the old blood wakes.

evolutions.choiceText: The knack is spreading — not stronger, wider. A second sense is waking up alongside the first.
evolutions.flavor: You were always more than one sense. You just never noticed.
evolutions.name: Second Sight
evolutions.verb: A second sense wakes: +25% early danger detection, always on.

evolutions.choiceText: The System's gift is germinating. It wants to grow beyond what was given — and the System is DELIGHTED.
evolutions.flavor: "OH! It's MOLTING! We didn't program molting! KEEP GOING!"
evolutions.name: Green Sovereign
evolutions.verb: The gift overgrows its bounds: +60% forage yield, plants lean toward you.

evolutions.choiceText: The System's gift is settling in — becoming hearth, not tool. Your camp is becoming something the System didn't design.
evolutions.flavor: "It's making a NEST?! The gift is making a NEST! The sponsors are crying!"
evolutions.name: Hearth King
evolutions.verb: Your camp becomes a hearth: food goes +30% further when you rest.

evolutions.name: Beautiful Chaos
evolutions.choiceText: The System's strangest gifts don't break. They BEND — and lately they've been bending toward you.
evolutions.flavor: "The chaos has a FAVORITE! It's YOU! The statisticians are furious!"
evolutions.verb: Randomness bends toward you: +20% luck on every roll the game makes.

evolutions.name: Method in Madness
evolutions.choiceText: The madness has a method and you've found it. The wacky gifts are starting to rhyme with each other.
evolutions.flavor: "It's COMPOSING! The nonsense is COMPOSING! Someone get this a RECORD DEAL!"
evolutions.verb: Strange gifts resonate: +50% synergy discovery when combining odd abilities.

evolutions.name: Apex Predator
evolutions.choiceText: The System's combat gift is done playing. It wants the red truth of the thing.
evolutions.flavor: "THERE it is! The KILLING shape! We KNEW it was in there!"
evolutions.verb: The gift becomes the hunt itself: +60% strike damage, and prey knows it.

evolutions.name: Untouchable
evolutions.choiceText: The System's combat gift has learned the other half of fighting: not being hit.
evolutions.flavor: "It DODGES now! The gift DODGES! Teach it to do taxes next!"
evolutions.verb: The gift learns evasion: +25% dodge chance, and it looks effortless.

evolutions.name: Beloved Monster
evolutions.choiceText: The System's social gift is flowering. The audience has a favorite, and it's you.
evolutions.flavor: "The polls! THE POLLS! You're WINNING the polls! We don't even know what the polls ARE!"
evolutions.verb: The gift becomes charisma itself: +60% trust from every social action.

evolutions.name: Puppet Master
evolutions.choiceText: The System's social gift has learned the strings. You're not persuading anymore — you're conducting.
evolutions.flavor: "It's playing them like an INSTRUMENT! A beautiful, ratings-friendly INSTRUMENT!"
evolutions.verb: Social leverage becomes control: +35% intimidation, and crowds follow your lead.

evolutions.name: Ascendant Horror
evolutions.choiceText: The dark gift is done pretending to be a tool. It wants to be what it is.
evolutions.flavor: "Oh no. OH NO. The dark one is BLOOMING. Ratings are UP though!"
evolutions.verb: The dark gift ascends: +80% damage, and enemies feel dread before you strike.

evolutions.name: Titan
evolutions.choiceText: The dark gift has stopped whispering and started offering. Power, plainly, at a price you'll pretend not to see.
evolutions.flavor: "The contract! It's writing its OWN contract! Legal is SCREAMING!"
evolutions.verb: The dark gift makes you vast: +50 max HP, and you feel every beat of it.
